en: A black-and-white photograph showing a city square with a park, people walking, vintage trams, and several prominent buildings. The most notable structure is an Orthodox cathedral with onion domes and crosses, situated to the right. To the left is a large governmental-looking building, and in the foreground is a landscaped area with paths and flowerbeds. The image has an old, historical feel.
